title: 5 Things to Remember if You've Been Laid Off
description:
Your first layoff will hurt. A lot. And probably your second too. And likely any layoff after that. There’s no such thing as an easy layoff, but as overwhelming and daunting as this chapter might feel you’re not alone. Here are 5 reminders to help you power through this challenging time. #layoff #layoffs #layofftips
